header: Every paper ships with a data statement
subheadline: Readers should see what a finding rests on before they decide how much to trust it.
content:
The statement sits directly under the abstract and names the analysis set, the embargo and the person who answers questions about it. Since March 2024 no Northstar paper has gone to print without one.

  • Analysis set with its own DOI
  • Embargo of up to 24 months
  • A named contact, not a shared inbox
